_readme: Recorded scores for the replay suites. The build fails if a suite drops below these.
Raise a number here only alongside the change that earned it, and never to make a red build green — that is the one edit this file exists to make somebody think twice about.
`scorers` are per-scorer floors. `completeness` deliberately has none: the coder is told to omit rather than guess, so ratcheting completeness upward would train the guessing the taxonomy forbids.
These describe this repository's deterministic code, not the model. See fixtures.ts.
